extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Qompass AI's personal voice-profile MCP server (stdio transport, rmcp, MCP modern era 2026-07-28): a measured writing fingerprint — sentence-length distribution, function-word profile, punctuation rates, parentheticals, hyphenated compounds, hedge/assertive balance, first-person rate — held over a corpus the owner keeps adding to, with verbatim exemplar retrieval by genre and a deterministic draft checker that scores text against the fingerprint and accounts for dropped numbers and broken URLs from a source. The fingerprint never changes silently: recompute is explicit, with a dry-run preview, and user corrections overlay the computed values. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Eigenstyle does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Eigenstyle

skills.description: The writing corpus behind the voice profile: the corpus manifest with metadata, word counts, included flags and totals, and adding new writing (text, file, or URL) with title, genre, and authorship (sole/blended) always required — samples are append-only and ingest never recomputes the fingerprint (list_corpus, ingest_sample).
skills.name: Corpus management

skills.description: The measured stylometric fingerprint and its readable profile: effective values (user corrections marked), leave-one-out bands, per-genre stats, and the avoid list; recompute re-derives the fingerprint and bands from included samples, with a dry-run preview of feature deltas and band shifts before anything is saved (get_profile, recompute_fingerprint).
skills.name: Fingerprint and profile

skills.description: Score a draft (text or file) against the fingerprint: verdict CLOSE / DRIFTING / OFF-VOICE / UNRELIABLE, the delta, the top contributing features, and avoid-list hits; with a source text or file, every number and URL from the source is accounted for and dropped numbers and dropped or broken URLs are reported (check_draft).
skills.name: Draft checking

skills.description: Verbatim exemplar paragraphs from included corpus samples of one genre — the retrieval bank agents draft against when writing in the profile owner's voice (get_exemplars).
skills.name: Exemplar retrieval
